name: KG state decay (nightly auto-close)
notes: [Re-enabled 2026-06-10 — full healing-loop enablement (audit follow-up): the 2026-05-10 POST-NUKE pause is over; pipeline rebuilt, scanner live since 2026-05-12, finding drains live since 2026-06-09.] Auto-closes State/Event nodes whose TTL has elapsed (uses attributes.last_observed + attributes.ttl, GRACE_DAYS=3). Runs after proposal_promoter (02:30) so freshly-promoted nodes are in the candidate set, and before wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00) so closures flow into the wiki the same night. Nightly cadence so the graph doesn't accumulate ghost-open states between weekly maintenance runs.
